01 · About

About me.

Hi, I’m Promothesh Chatterjee, a second-year B.Tech CSE student at Heritage Institute of Technology, Kolkata.

I don’t want to learn in silos. I want to connect the dots between the systems that quietly run our world: models, markets, networks and the maths underneath them.

Over four years of public speaking and debate taught me to explain hard ideas clearly and lead people, which is exactly what I want to bring to GDG as its Machine Learning Lead.
